text: Program DescriptionThe curriculum planning shall include the following three parts:(1) Chinese culture and natural science courses. In order to facilitate their learning and life in China and contact with patients in their medical practice, the Chinese language shall be a compulsory course during the whole undergraduate medical program in English for international students in China.(2) Basic medical sciences, behavioral science, humanities, social science and medical ethics, preventive medicine and clinical medicine. It is also required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively.(3) Internship. The institutions shall meticulously organize the reasonable arrangement of the internship. The duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks).Main Courses:Over 55 compulsory courses and over 7 optional courses: Cytobiology, Human Anatomy, Human Micropics Morphology Experiment, parasitology, Experiment of Microbilogy & Immunology, Pathology, Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Medical Genetics, Forensic Medicine, Hygienic Statistics, Community Medicine, Epidemiology, Occupational Health & Safety, Environment & Health, Food Hygiene, Nutrition & Diseases, Medical Psychology, Medical Ethics, Diagnostics Basic, Image Diagnosis, Acupuncture Therapy etc.Internship:In the final academic year, MBBS students need to do the internship for one year (at least 48 weeks). They can choose to do it in China, their home country or any other country.Those who do their internship in other countries, other than in CQMU, only need to pay 20% of the tuition fee of that year. According to Nepalese Government, students from Nepal are not allowed to do internship back in Nepal. For more details, please visit the Internship and Career.Fee Structure:Bedding (Optional): RMB 500 (First year only)Damage Deposit: RMB 500 (First year only)Tuition: 30,000 RMB/yearAccommodation: 4,800RMB/Year (Double room); 9,600 RMB/Year (Single room)Insurance Fee: 600 RMB/yearCost of Living: 700~1,000 RMB/MonthIn Total: 45,250 ~53,650 RMB/YearScholarships:Students in this program can apply for: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship.Degree Awarded:MBBS Degree: upon graduation, students need to pass the HSK 3 (New HSK 4) to get the diploma.On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by CQMU, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery).
